title: Nonnegativity of the fragmentation power-series solution for finite nonnegative daughter measures without endpoint atoms and compactly supported nonnegative initial measures
author: Marie Doumic, Miguel Escobedo and Magali Tournus
work: An inverse problem: recovering the fragmentation kernel from the short-time behaviour of the fragmentation equation
source_version: Official published version, Annales Henri Lebesgue 7 (2024), 621-671, 10.5802/ahl.207
difficulty_reason: The author proof regularizes both an atomic initial state and the daughter kernel, establishes uniform factorial bounds for signed expansion coefficients, and passes two distinct limits through multiplicative convolutions in bounded-Lipschitz topology. This complete measure-kernel fragmentation positivity construction exceeds qualification PDE.
